item.title: 1 hospitalized in critical condition after auto-pedestrian crash in Midvale
item.description: An auto-pedestrian crash in Midvale left one person in critical condition early Sunday morning, according to Unified Police.

item.title: Utah 2034 to be represented in Milano Cortina 2026 Olympic Torch Relay
item.description: Just eight years out from Utah's very own Olympic games, Utah 2034 is set to have a strong presence in Milano Cortina this year, beginning with joining the 2026 Olympic Torch Relay.

item.title: Spikes deployed in high-speed chase in Box Elder County, suspect facing felony charge
item.description: One person is in custody and facing multiple charges after a high-speed pursuit involving multiple enforcement agencies on Saturday afternoon.

item.title: Provo man gets third DUI in 2 months after crashing into deputy's vehicle at stop sign
item.description: A man crashed into the back of a police vehicle at a stop sign in Springville on Sunday, marking his third DUI charge in the last two months in the state of Utah, according to the Utah County Sheriff's Office. Authorities said he has had nearly a dozen DUIs spanning multiple states in the last 15 years.

item.description: Elder Patrick Kearon of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hosted a worldwide devotional for young adults on Sunday evening.

item.title: Family of 22-year-old victim in Box Elder Co. fatal crash remembers his life, encourages road safety
item.description: The family of the 22-year-old man who was killed in a fatal crash in Box Elder County on Thursday is reflecting on the life that was lost.

item.title: Woman born in vanished Utah mining town celebrates 100th birthday
item.description: Born in a "now vanished" Utah mining town, Faye Henderson Drage has truly lived a life encapsulated by resilience. On Sunday, she celebrated her 100th birthday in Spanish Fork, surrounded by a community that admires her legacy.
